description: The only way to leave work running on its own: a named client flow with a trigger and results, and the cron that actually delivers it
client_copy: Lo que se repite queda armado como un flujo y anda solo.
_comment: IT DEPENDS ON kanban AND approval. Every run lands as a ticket, and a flow
that acts on the client's behalf goes through the approval gate like
anything else -- a scheduled job is not a licence to skip the yes.
THE ENGINE SURFACE IS REAL AND IT DOES NOT MOVE IN THIS PHASE. It is
hook), the one place in the kit that already uses the ENGINE's own plugin
system. Bringing it in means changing where the compose mounts it --
policy/plugins is mounted at /opt/data/plugins read only and config.yaml's
`plugins.enabled` names it -- and phase 2 does not touch the install
layout. It migrates in phase 3, with the agent-side loader.
